title: Clinical Assessment of Patients With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) and/or Chronic Heart Failure (CHF)
brief_summary: Cigarette smoking, the major risk factor for COPD, causes not only airway and lung inflammation, but also systemic effects. These systemic effects of smoking could substantially contribute to the development of chronic diseases, other than COPD, particularly chronic heart failure (CHF). The aim of this project is to assess the frequency and severity of CHF and COPD in outpatients with history of smoking referred to Hospital because of dyspnea and/or chronic cough.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Caucasians
* Males and females
* Age \> 50 years
* Smoking history \> 10 pack years
* Diagnosis of COPD according to GOLD 2008 and/or diagnosis of CHF according to ESC 2008

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of bronchial asthma
* Fixed airflow limitation due to other chronic diseases such as cystic fibrosis, bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia (BOOP), bronchiectasis, TBC etc.
* Combined restrictive-obstructive functional impairment
study_population: 100 patients older than 50 years with diagnosis of COPD and/or CHF, male or female, smokers or ex-smokers with more than 10 pack-years, in stable conditions.
